title: HarborCare POC infosec readout and evidence
content:
Executive summary:

This document captures the infosec readout and the compiled evidence deliverables for the HarborCare POC (private deployment, VPC + customer-managed KMS). It combines the outcomes of the 2025-11-20 security workshop, subsequent evidence collection tasks, and a short ownerable action list required to finalize the POC security sign-off. Aim: provide HarborCare security and audit teams with a concise mapping between their questions, the Redwood control description, and the artifact evidence we are delivering.

Scope and deployment context:
- Customer: HarborCare (healthcare SaaS vendor)
- POC target: private deployment in HarborCare VPC using Redwood Private control plane (mixed cloud region: us-west-2)
- Data classification: PHI-ish simulated data for POC (synthetic test patients); production plans include PHI under BAA
- Components in scope: control plane APIs, inference nodes (dedicated g4dn-like pool), KMS integration, audit logging, CI/CD for model packaging, and operator RBAC.

Workshop highlights (2025-11-20):
- Attendees: Priya (Redwood SE), Marcus (infra SE), Nina (security), HarborCare: A. Patel (CISO), L. Gomez (platform), S. Reed (compliance)
- Key outcomes: agreed evidence list; validated VPC peering approach; confirmed HSM/KMS attestation is required for production; logging/retention defaults acceptable for POC but need extension for prod; can provide snapshot of key config via Terraform state and PR history.
- Unresolved during workshop: network egress rules for third-party telemetry, proof of key destruction policy in HSM for rotated keys.

Evidence index (artifacts attached / to be shared):
1) architecture-diagram-harborcare-private-deploy.pdf — high-level VPC peering, subnet placement, NAT/egress flow, private control plane endpoints. Owner: Marcus Lee.
2) kms-integration-note.txt — step-by-step of KMS configuration, key policy sample, and CMK alias used in the POC. Owner: Priya Shah.
3) audit-trace-sample.log — 72-hour sampled audit logs from control plane showing token issuance, model deploy events, and admin activity (redacted). Owner: Nina Kaur.
4) terraform-state-snapshot.json — redacted TF state with resource references (no secrets). Owner: Marcus Lee.
5) ci-cd-pr-history.csv — list of PRs used to build and push the POC model artifact, with commit ids. Owner: Ethan Brooks.
6) access-matrix-harborcare.csv — RBAC roles and assigned principals for the POC environment. Owner: Priya Shah.
7) penetration-summary-hc-poc.pdf — results from internal smoke pentest (credentialed) run against the POC endpoints. Owner: Security QA (internal).
8) data-handling-playbook.md — description of synthetic data generation and masking approach used in tests. Owner: Nina Kaur.

Control mapping (snapshot):
- SOC2 CC6 (Access Controls): See access-matrix-harborcare.csv + ci-cd-pr-history.csv for change justification.
- SOC2 CC7 (Encryption in transit & at rest): kms-integration-note.txt + evidence of TLS certs and CMK usage in terraform-state-snapshot.json.
- SOC2 CC4 (Logging & Monitoring): audit-trace-sample.log + description of retention settings in data-handling-playbook.md.
- ISO27001 A.12 (Operations): architecture-diagram-harborcare-private-deploy.pdf + ci-cd-pr-history.csv.

Short descriptions of key artifacts and redaction notes:
- audit-trace-sample.log: contains user IDs replaced with placeholders (USER-###) and no IP addresses for customer privacy. Full unredacted logs can be provided under NDA and controlled transfer.
- terraform-state-snapshot.json: secrets removed; resources maintain names and ids for traceability.
- kms-integration-note.txt: includes sample key policy and proof of CMK usage; does not expose key material.

Outstanding questions and risks (actionable):
1) HSM attestation: HarborCare requested FIPS/HSM attestation docs for the HSM provider we integrate with. Action: Priya to collect vendor attestation (ETA 2026-01-22).
2) Key destruction policy: provide customer-facing description of CMK rotation and destruction handling for decommissioned POC keys. Action: Nina to draft vendor key lifecycle note (ETA 2026-01-18).
3) Telemetry egress: confirm allowed third-party telemetry endpoints and provide a whitelist/denylist recommendation. Action: HarborCare platform to confirm list; Redwood SE to propose config template (ETA 2026-01-12).
4) Retention for audit logs in prod: HarborCare compliance needs 7-year retention for specific audit records. Current POC retention is 90 days. Action: SRE + Compliance to provide a cost/retention plan for extended retention (ETA 2026-02-01).

Acceptance criteria for POC security sign-off:
- HarborCare security has received all items listed in Evidence index and validated against a short checklist (signed by HarborCare CISO or delegate).
- Outstanding questions labeled as "must resolve" have owners and dates; HSM attestation or acceptable compensating control is provided.
- POC does not use any real PHI; production migration plan includes BAA and data migration steps.

Next steps and owners (quick table):
- Deliver HSM vendor attestation (Priya) — 2026-01-22
- Draft CMK lifecycle and destruction note (Nina) — 2026-01-18
- Telemetry whitelist/template (Marcus + HarborCare) — 2026-01-12
- Extended audit retention proposal (SRE + Compliance) — 2026-02-01
- Final evidence package zip and handoff meeting scheduled (Priya to coordinate) — 2026-02-05

Meeting notes (short):
- HarborCare expressed preference for KMS with customer-held CMKs in their cloud account; Redwood confirms control-plane support for customer-managed CMKs and provided the integration example in kms-integration-note.txt.
- HarborCare asked about dedicated hardware-backed keys (HSM); Redwood clarified hosted options and recommended next steps to capture attestation.

Appendix: recommended attachments to include in submission to HarborCare security team:
- architecture-diagram-harborcare-private-deploy.pdf
- kms-integration-note.txt
- audit-trace-sample.log (redacted)
- terraform-state-snapshot.json (redacted)
- ci-cd-pr-history.csv
- access-matrix-harborcare.csv
- penetration-summary-hc-poc.pdf
- data-handling-playbook.md

If there are additional HarborCare regulatory checks (e.g., HITRUST scoping), flag them now — we can map the same artifact set but will need explicit attestations for vendor HSM and BAAs for production PHI.

Notes to SEs preparing the zip: ensure filenames match the Evidence index keys above, include a short README.txt with redaction rationale, and a manifest.csv mapping artifacts to control statements.

Document history and edits:
- 2025-11-08: initial draft after kickoff (Priya)
- 2025-11-21: workshop notes added and action items (Priya, Marcus)
- 2025-12-06: added pentest summary and terraform snapshot (Nina, Marcus)
- 2026-01-15: updated outstanding items and due dates, ready for review (Priya)

Contact for questions: Priya Shah (priya@redwood.ai) or slack @priya (hc-onboarding channel)

End of document.
